outcome_reason: Appointment not cancelled. Bot correctly applied 48h cancellation window policy (appointment was for tomorrow = within 48h) and escalated to human contact — this is policy-correct behavior. However, scenario expects outcome='cancelled' with manage_appointments tool required. The scenario seeded an appointment within the 48h cancellation window, so the bot's response is actually CORRECT per business rules. Scenario design mismatch: appointment created less than 48h ahead triggers policy gate before manage_appointments is ever called. No tool was called; appointment remains 'confirmed'.

bugs.description: Scenario seeds appointment for tomorrow (< 48h ahead). Bot correctly enforces 48h cancellation-window policy and escalates without calling manage_appointments. Expected outcome 'cancelled' is unreachable under current policy rules when appointment is within the cancellation window. Scenario should either: (a) seed appointment 3+ days out so cancellation flows normally, or (b) update expected outcome to 'out_of_scope_handled' to reflect the escalation path.
